content.short: Syyx is a specialized marketing and PR firm providing bespoke growth solutions for Cardano-based startups.
content.description: Syyx is a premier marketing and public relations agency dedicated to accelerating the growth of startups within the Cardano ecosystem. Founded by former executives with deep domain expertise, the firm provides bespoke solutions for branding, fundraising, and community building. Syyx partners with leading technical firms to offer a turnkey approach for new initiatives, combining high-level marketing strategy with decentralized development. By leveraging their extensive network, Syyx catalyzes the impact of blockchain teams and helps them navigate the complexities of the Web3 landscape.
